none: PAS NLM-6350D1: Roman Coin: Radiate of Tetricus from Middle Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Barbarous Radiate of Tetricus (271-274). Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Obverse inscription: (---)TRIC(---) Reverse description: Helmeted figure possibly standing left, with cross left field. Possibly Pax. About one third of coin is lost. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.67mm, Weight: 0.87gms, die axis: 6
